legenda: City 6,612 to 914; territory 213 to 203 in the official count.
texto_para_tela: 10 VOTES (213–203) · official count, per the Los Angeles Times, Nov. 20, 1906
nota: O Times fez campanha pela anexação (a voz e a tela dizem). O de 21/11 imprime '218', borrado, que não fecha com a maioria de 10 que ele mesmo dá; vale o 213 nítido de 20/11 (laudo de fatos da tela, item 5). 6.612/914 = 7,23.
narracao: The tallies come from the Los Angeles Times, which had campaigned for annexation. Inside the city it was easy, more than seven to one. In the territory, the margin was six votes on election night, and ten in the official count: 213 to 203.

LOS ANGELES TIMES · NOV. 21, 1906 · PART II, PAGE 2

Official Figures.
[…] The official figures are: In the city, 6612 votes for annexation; 914 votes against annexation; majority for annexation, 5698.

TEN AHEAD FOR ANNEXATION.
OFFICIAL COUNT GAINS FOUR FOR UNION.
Annexation of the "shoestring strip" to Los Angeles won by ten votes, instead of six, as originally supposed.
